description: Heuristic syntax validation for a Mermaid diagram definition: recognizes flowchart/graph, sequenceDiagram, classDiagram, stateDiagram(-v2), erDiagram, and pie by their header keyword, then runs diagram-specific structural checks (unterminated subgraph, unbalanced brackets, malformed edges for flowcharts; a participant referenced before its explicit declaration for sequence diagrams). A line-based heuristic, not a full Mermaid grammar; never renders the diagram.

diagram.description: The full Mermaid diagram definition text

name: validate_mermaid_syntax
